```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

This dataset contains 8 variables including species, island, bill length(mm), bill depth(mm), flipper length(mm), body mass(g), sex and year. 
The size of the dataset is `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.
The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.

```{r warning=FALSE}

plot_df = 
  tibble(
    x = pull(penguins, bill_length_mm),
    y = pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm),
    color = pull(penguins, species)
  )
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = color)) + geom_point()
ggsave("flipper_bill_scatterplot.png")
```
